commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a 16 MiB bounded transcript read/tail parsing path to session-memory and adds a regression test for oversized transcript tail messages.

PR surface: Source +48, Tests +16. Total +64 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main calls fs.readFile on the whole session-memory transcript, and the PR body includes terminal proof against an oversized transcript path. I did not run a fresh live repro in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] There is a concrete PR-branch repair: replace the custom bounded tail scanner with the existing shared transcript streaming helper while preserving session-memory-specific filtering.

target.title: fix(session-memory): bound session transcript reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`getRecentSessionContent` in `src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/transcript.ts` reads session transcript JSONL files with an unbounded `fs.promises.readFile` call. A runaway or corrupted session file could force the session-memory extraction path to buffer the entire file into memory, leading to OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

Session transcripts are line-oriented JSONL files. A 16 MiB cap is generous headroom for long sessions while preventing the memory-extraction path from being used as a memory exhaustion vector. For transcripts that exceed the cap, the helper reads only the trailing 16 MiB and drops the first partial JSONL line so parsing starts at a complete record. This preserves recent session context instead of discarding the whole transcript.

## User Impact

Session-memory extraction now safely bounds oversized transcripts while still keeping the most recent messages available for context.

## Evidence

- Added a regression test that writes a transcript exceeding the 16 MiB cap with recent trailing messages and asserts those recent messages are preserved.
- Local focused run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/transcript.test.ts --run` passes (4/4 tests).

## Real behavior proof (standalone)

I ran a standalone Node script outside Vitest that imports the actual changed helper from source (`src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/transcript.ts`) and exercises a transcript larger than the 16 MiB cap where the trailing lines contain recent messages.

Script: `/tmp/proof-101475.mjs` (not committed).

```text
$ node --import tsx /tmp/proof-101475.mjs
=== Oversized transcript ===
File size: 17826089 bytes (cap is 16777216 bytes)
Result contains recent user message: true
Result contains recent assistant message: true
Result does NOT contain the huge early message: true
```

The helper reads only the trailing 16 MiB of the oversized file, skips the partial first line, and returns the recent messages without buffering the entire transcript into memory.
